KarteaPalettes

class KarteaPalettes[source]

Bases: object

Single table of the track color palettes.

Class with only class attributes and class methods, following the KarteaPathConfig pattern: it is not instantiated.

Attributes:
DEFAULTint, class attribute

Number of the palette used when the value is empty or invalid (0, “Padrão”).

ALLMapping[int, Palette], class attribute

Read-only {number: Palette}, in increasing number order.

_PALETTESdict[int, Palette], class attribute

Source table of ALL; where new palettes are added.

Notes

The palette names and descriptions are marked for translation with QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP in the _TR_VIEW_CONTEXT context (“PlayerKarteaConfigEditView”); the edit screen translates them with self.tr() (i18n).

Methods

get

Return the palette matching value (see id_of).

id_of

Return a valid palette number from any value.
classmethod id_of(value)[source]

Return a valid palette number from any value.

Parameters:
valueAny

Int or text (as it comes from the CSV or kartea.ini).

Returns:
int

The palette number; empty, invalid or unknown values become DEFAULT.

Examples

>>> KarteaPalettes.id_of("3")
3
>>> KarteaPalettes.id_of("99"), KarteaPalettes.id_of(None)
(0, 0)
classmethod get(value)[source]

Return the palette matching value (see id_of).

Parameters:
valueAny

Int or text palette number.

Returns:
Palette

The palette, or the DEFAULT one for invalid values.

Examples

>>> KarteaPalettes.get("1").name
'Suave'
